concurrency: Single owning writer; finalize/abort are mutually exclusive; recovery is read-only and may run concurrently with nothing that writes.
dependencies: accepted xverse_xdl.experiment_plan public API/digest semantics (read-only, unchanged)
accepted C++ X-COM observation contract 1.0.0 (read-only, unchanged)
deployment: Offline, in-process Python library and console entry point inside the admitted ARGUS2 envelope: no process, service, container, network, device, provider handle, live tap, registry or oracle is created, started, probed or contacted.
rationale: Source allocation from docs/engineering/argus-lite/requirements.md ARGUS2-SR-006, realized by ARGUS2-ARCH-06/ARGUS2-ARCH-02 in docs/engineering/argus-lite/architecture.md section 4 and frozen in docs/engineering/argus-lite/detailed-design.md.
responsibilities: Enforce exactly one owning writer per run and the new -> open -> closed / open -> failed state machine.
Reject reuse or overwrite of an existing run and reject a second concurrent or repeated writer.
Document and perform the flush/fsync/rename boundaries and bounded local partial-write handling.
Recover by reading bounded prefixes only and report incomplete or damaged evidence without rewriting, upgrading or mutating the original evidence files.
state_ownership: Owns the single-writer state, the open stream handle and the durable manifest/stream bytes for the run; no other component writes them.
title: ARGUS2-SR-006-CMP allocation - Single-writer state, durability and non-mutating recovery
